 Print Sharad Kapoor to make his Hollywood debut in January amid viral appeal for work: 'I've already got an offer for a film' Actor Sharad Kapoor , who played a key role in the 2000 film ‘ Josh ’, has addressed a viral video in which he was seen leaving his four pet dogs at an animal shelter. In a recent interaction, he said a leg injury left him unable to look after them. Sharad Kapoor on why he left his dogs at a shelter
 Speaking to HT City, Sharad Kapoor said that the injury happened during a football match in Barcelona. He explained that caring for four dogs needs daily effort, which he could not manage while hurt. “I went to Barcelona to play football. I suffered a massive injury after my foot collided with another player’s while playing there. As my leg got injured, I couldn’t take care of my four dogs. You need to take them out; they need proper care, and the house gets very dirty,” he shared. Sharad Kapoor says the doctor advised him two months of rest
 Sharad Kapoor said his orthopaedic surgeon, Dr Anand Joshi, has asked him to stay in bed for two months. "My doctor advised bed rest and said that in two months, I’ll be absolutely fine and won’t have any problems. So, I will be back in shape. I also intend to bring my pets back home. This is a temporary solution, seeing that I can’t care for them right now," he said. Sharad Kapoor talks about his plan to shift to a bigger home
 The actor also revealed that he wants a larger space for his pets and has already made a booking for a new property. “I’m selling the house I’m currently staying in and shifting to Mud Island. I’ve already paid an advance for that bungalow. It has seven bedrooms and ample space for my dogs. They can stay there peacefully. This was always the plan, to bring my pets back home,” he added. Sharad Kapoor clarifies his appeal for work
 Another clip of Sharad Kapoor asking industry colleagues for work has also been doing the rounds online. The actor, who has not been seen on screen for two to three years, said the video was not a plea for money or a dig at anyone. “I was staying in New York for the past seven years. I came back only a year ago. The purpose of the video was not to badmouth my peers. My industry is full of my people. They’re like my family. I don’t need monetary help, and I’ve never chosen to do projects for that reason either,” he said. Join conversation

 Hollywood debut on the cards
 Sharad Kapoor also shared that he has bagged a Hollywood project, which will be his first international film, with shooting set to begin in January. “If we badmouth each other, it gives the public a reason to badmouth us too. I’ve already got an offer for a Hollywood film, which I’m going to start in January. I am also going to continue working on Bollywood projects. This is my country. As soon as I recover fully in two months, things will get back on track,” he concluded. The actor was last seen in the film 'Cabaret', starring Richa Chadha in the lead role. The film was released in January 2019.
